changeLog: v1.1: Added mlGlobalFallbackSigma=1.5. When an ML source (S22/S23) falls back to a GLOBAL large-stone tail (no spec-specific coverage), it is now given sigma=1.5 instead of the normal mlSigma=0.22. This reduces its blend weight from ~20% to ~1%, allowing the StarGem lookup and comp engine to dominate when ML has no coverage. Fixes extreme underpricing for near-10ct D-VVS1 stones where GLOBAL fallback returned $177-$215 and was corrupting the geometric mean.
